verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
There is none holy like the Lord
There is none beside You
There is no fortress like our God
Who was and is and is to come
The beginning and the end
Son of God, Son of Man
There is no one like You, Lord, so holy

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Holy holy holy is the Lord
All glory, glory, glory to the Lord
Almighty, so worthy, we give you all the praise
Oh Lamb of God ,You're holy

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
Holy Holy Holy
Lord God Almighty
Worthy worthy worthy
Of all the praise and glory
Holy Holy Holy
Lord God almighty
Worthy worthy worthy
Of all the praise and glory

verse.name: o2
verse.lines: Oh lamb of God You're holy

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
We give you all the glory
We worship You our Lord
You are worthy to be praised
